entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a polished 3D CEL-SHADED CHARACTER MODEL DESIGN SHEET from the two supplied Joseph Smith references. Image1 is the ADULT Joseph identity and navy 1840s costume reference; image2 is the YOUTH Joseph identity and farm clothing reference. Preserve recognizable facial continuity, blue eyes, wavy light brown hair and dignified approachable humanity. A landscape artbook sheet with FIVE evenly spaced fully visible front-three-quarter A-pose figures: seven-year-old Joseph in simple 1810s clothes; fourteen-year-old Joseph in cream farm shirt brown trousers and period suspenders; twenty-three-year-old Joseph in an 1829 work shirt and waistcoat; thirty-eight-year-old Joseph in the navy coat waistcoat cream neckcloth of image1; the SAME thirty-eight-year-old face as a celestial stewardship variation in simple cream robes, no wings no armor no crown. Young and child versions must have correct differing height proportions, not scaled-down adult heads. This is a clean stylized 3D game render with sculpted smooth readable volumes, THREE OR FOUR CRISP DISCRETE shadow bands, warm brown ink contours #2a1a14, broad flat material colors, soft colored ambient fill, no photographic pores or cloth weave, no shiny PBR skin. Strong clear silhouette, expressive human face, NO aggressive triangular low-poly facets over cheeks, no chibi and no anime giant eyes. Neutral warm gray studio background and even neutral light, feet grounded on one baseline. Hands and fingers fully visible, fingers separated, arms angled down 30 degrees away from torso in relaxed modeling A-pose, at least 8% margin around every figure, never crop fingertips or shoes. Small face close-up row above showing curiosity prayer grief consolation joy for adult Joseph. Simple exact labels beneath five figures: 'CHILD', 'YOUTH', 'TRANSLATOR', 'NAUVOO', 'CELESTIAL'. No other text or decorative props. Production-oriented character concepts, not a claim of authenticated historical likeness. High resolution wide composition.
